items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: Erroll Garner formed a trio later with Harold "Doc" West and Red Callender and him, and I was on some sets with them.

ctx.x: And the next group that came in to alternate with us, like our intermission group, was Kay Starr and her group. That was before she ever recorded!

And in the meantime, Erroll Garner had just come out. He was working diagonally across the street at the Suzy Q. He had just won the Esquire Poll and everything, it was his first trip to California, and he was doing real good. That's when I first met him. And...
